title: C–H functionalization through benzylic deprotonation with π-coordination or cation–π-interactions
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,2520-2542
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00466C, Review Article
Hui Zhu(s), Yu Wu, Jianyou Mao, Jingkai Xu, Patrick J. Walsh, Hang Shi
Transition-metals bind arene π-systems, removing e− density and acidifying benzylic C–H’s. Main group metals achieve this via cation–π interactions. Both interactions enable catalytic base-promoted selective C–H functionalization.
